title: Deceive Oneself
simplified_paragraphs: 从前，有一个小偷看到一口漂亮的大钟，想把它背回自己家去。可是钟又大又重，想要拿回去只有一个办法，那就是把钟敲碎，然后再分别搬回家。
小偷找来一把大锤子，用力地敲了一下。钟发出了很大的声音，把他吓了一大跳。他一下子抱住了大钟，想捂住钟声，可钟声又怎么捂得住呢！小偷很着急，心想，这钟声不是在告诉人们我正在这里偷钟吗？
他越听越害怕，不由自主地用手捂住了自己的耳朵。"竟然听不见了！”小偷高兴起来。他以为别人也听不见了，于是用布把耳朵塞住，用力地敲钟。钟声响亮地传到很远的地方，人们听到钟声后，跑过来把小偷捉住了。
traditional_paragraphs: 從前，有一個小偷看到一口漂亮的大鐘，想把它背回自己家去。可是鐘又大又重，想要拿回去只有一個辦法，那就是把鐘敲碎，然後再分別搬回家。
小偷找來一把大錘子，用力地敲了一下。鐘發出了很大的聲音，把他嚇了一大跳。他一下子抱住了大鐘，想捂住鐘聲，可鐘聲又怎麼捂得住呢！小偷很著急，心想，這鐘聲不是在告訴人們我正在這裡偷鐘嗎？
他越聽越害怕，不由自主地用手捂住了自己的耳朵。"竟然聽不見了！”小偷高興起來。他以為別人也聽不見了，於是用布把耳朵塞住，用力地敲鐘。鐘聲響亮地傳到很遠的地方，人們聽到鐘聲後，跑過來把小偷捉住了。
pinyin_paragraphs: cóng qián， yǒu yī gè xiǎo tōu kàn dào yī kǒu piào liang de dà zhōng， xiǎng bǎ tā bēi huí zì jǐ jiā qù。 kě shì zhōng yòu dà yòu zhòng， xiǎng yào ná huí qù zhǐ yǒu yī gè bàn fǎ， nà jiù shì bǎ zhōng qiāo suì， rán hòu zài fēn bié bān huí jiā。

xiǎo tōu zhǎo lái yī bǎ dà chuí zi， yòng lì de qiāo le yī xià。 zhōng fā chū le hěn dà de shēng yīn， bǎ tā xià le yī dà tiào。 tā yī xià zi bào zhù le dà zhōng， xiǎng wǔ zhù zhōng shēng， kě zhōng shēng yòu zěn me wǔ de zhù ne！ xiǎo tōu hěn zháo jí， xīn xiǎng， zhè zhōng shēng bù shì zài gào su rén men wǒ zhèng zài zhè lǐ tōu zhōng ma？

tā yuè tīng yuè hài pà， bù yóu zì zhǔ de yòng shǒu wǔ zhù le zì jǐ de ěr duo。" jìng rán tīng bù jiàn le！” xiǎo tōu gāo xìng qǐ lái。 tā yǐ wéi bié rén yě tīng bù jiàn le， yú shì yòng bù bǎ ěr duo sāi zhù， yòng lì de qiāo zhōng。 zhōng shēng xiǎng liàng de chuán dào hěn yuǎn de dì fang， rén men tīng dào zhōng shēng hòu， pǎo guò lái bǎ xiǎo tōu zhuō zhù le。
english_paragraphs: Once upon a time, a thief saw a beautiful, large bell and wanted to carry it home. But the bell was so big and heavy that he could only think of one way to take it: break it into pieces and carry them home separately.

The thief found a large hammer and struck the bell hard. It made a loud sound that gave him a fright. He threw his arms around the bell, trying to muffle the sound—but how could he? The thief grew anxious. Wasn’t the ringing telling everyone he was stealing the bell?

The more he listened, the more frightened he became. Without thinking, he covered his ears with his hands. “I can’t hear it anymore!” he said happily. He thought no one else could hear it either, so he plugged his ears with cloth and struck the bell again and again. Its loud ringing carried far and wide. When people heard it, they came running and caught the thief.
english_full:
Once upon a time, a thief saw a beautiful, large bell and wanted to carry it home. But the bell was so big and heavy that he could only think of one way to take it: break it into pieces and carry them home separately.

The thief found a large hammer and struck the bell hard. It made a loud sound that gave him a fright. He threw his arms around the bell, trying to muffle the sound—but how could he? The thief grew anxious. Wasn’t the ringing telling everyone he was stealing the bell?

The more he listened, the more frightened he became. Without thinking, he covered his ears with his hands. “I can’t hear it anymore!” he said happily. He thought no one else could hear it either, so he plugged his ears with cloth and struck the bell again and again. Its loud ringing carried far and wide. When people heard it, they came running and caught the thief.
